in_hebrew.name: דליני
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew word 'dela', which means 'godly'. This name could be derived from Delilah, the biblical character known for her betrayal of Samson.

in_greek.name: Δηλαινη
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek word 'delaino', which means 'to show clearly' or 'to make plain'. This name could be derived from Delia, a Greek goddess of the moon and the harvest.

in_latin.name: Delainia
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin 'delare', which means 'to make clear' or 'to reveal'. This name could be derived from Delia, a Roman goddess of the harvest.
